source_caption:
🎬 Palmer (2021)

Palmer follows Eddie Palmer, a former college football star who returns to his hometown in Louisiana after serving 12 years in prison. Determined to rebuild his life and leave his troubled past behind, Eddie struggles to find work and regain the trust of his community. His life takes an unexpected turn when he forms a friendship with Sam, a young boy who faces bullying and rejection for being different. As their bond grows stronger, Eddie becomes a protective father figure, discovering a new sense of purpose and responsibility. However, his criminal record and the challenges surrounding Sam’s family threaten the life they are building together. Starring Justin Timberlake, Palmer delivers an emotional story about second chances, compassion, acceptance, and the power of unconditional love.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 50m • R

🎥 Director: Fisher Stevens

✍️ Writer: Cheryl Guerriero

📺 Where to Watch: Apple TV+ in the United States. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: Palmer is a 2021 American drama film directed by Fisher Stevens and written by Cheryl Guerriero. The film stars Justin Timberlake, Juno Temple, Alisha Wainwright, June Squibb, and Ryder Allen. Palmer was digitally released by Apple TV+ on January 29, 2021. The film received positive reviews from critics, who praised the performances and themes though noted its familiarity.
